title: Bali Sakina Roti Hai
body:
Aye Baba Payare Baba
Bali sakeena Roti hai Baba Baba kaheti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Bali sakeena Roti hai zulm ye kitni saheti hai
Aye Baba Payare Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
(1)
Ammu nahi Akbar Bhi nahi
Haye koi yawar Bhi nahi
Kiske sahare Ab mai jiu’n
Had hai mera asghar bhi nahi
Teer gale par uske mara
Jal gaya sholo’n me gahewara
<<DIVIDER>>
(2)
Rooh meri dukh payi hai
Aankh meri bhar aayi hai
Qaid mera ek bhai hai
Qismat me tanhayi hai
Chut gaye mere sare sahare
So gaye Ammu naher kanare
<<DIVIDER>>
(3)
Sahe Liya sadma asghar ka
Dard hai dil me akbar ka
Hye hye dagh bahattar ka
Kaise ho matam ghar bhar ka
Mooh pe tamache kab tak kahu’n
Kab tak chup kar ashq bahau’n
<<DIVIDER>>
(4)
Sahe ke tamacho’n ke yalgaar
Neel hue mere rukshar
Ek qadam pe so so Baar
Pusht pe durro’n ki bauchar
Dil ke sab Armaan hai zakhmi
Chin gaye gohar kaan hai zakhmi
<<DIVIDER>>
(5)
Rukh pe tamachon ke hai nishaan
Khoon ke aansu Rote hain kaan
Itna souch ke hoon hairan
Tanha mai or ye zindan
Qaid se chut kar jab jayenge
Chode ke mujhko sab jayenge
<<DIVIDER>>
(6)
Tum se Bichad kar neend kahan
Ab hai bichauna renge tapa’n
Koi nahi hum dard yahan
Chatkhe hain lab sukhi zaban
Dard bhari rudad sunega
Kon meri fariyad sunega
<<DIVIDER>>
(7)
Gurbat ke ahesas ka sadma
Tooti hui har aas ka sadma
Bhuk ka sadma payas ka sadma
Haye chacha abbas ka sadma
Ab nahi kahete koi sakeena
Sab kahete hain mujhko yateema
<<DIVIDER>>
(8)
Aale nabi ka gham fakhri
Kaise likhenge hum fakhri
Nam aankhen hain aye Mahfooz
Karte raho matam fakhri
Tha wo qayamat jaisa manzar
Royi sakeena jab ye kahe kar
author: Fakhri Meeruthi
